description: This file defines a wizard for importing invoices into a bank statement within an Odoo module, including UI forms, search, and population logic.

classes.name: PopulateStatementFromInv
classes.description: Wizard class for populating bank statement with invoices

methods.name: _search_invoices
methods.description: Searches for invoice move lines based on selected criteria and updates the form with results

methods.name: _populate_statement
methods.description: Populates the bank statement with selected invoice lines, reconciling and creating statement lines
